description: Convert any document to clean Markdown for an LLM: PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), web pages (main content only), TXT, CSV, MD, JSON. Send {url} or {base64, filename}. Returns markdown plus format, title, pages/sheets/slides and warnings. Tables kept as Markdown tables. Price: $0.01 per successful call via x402 (eip155:8453); 5 free calls/day across all tools.

base64.description: File content, base64 (alternative to url, max ~25 MB)

filename.description: File name with extension, helps format detection

max_chars.description: Truncate markdown to this many chars (default 100000)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the document or web page

name: convert_document
title: Convert document to Markdown
